liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (3 reviews): Reviewer praises the jamming at the end of Foolish Heart as amazing and a long-time favorite; Reviewer says Garcia delivers an amazing Foolish Heart [13][14][16]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer's group reached their seats just as the Jack Straw opener was ending; Reviewer says the Jack Straw opener was strong [6][9]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer says the Music Never Stopped made a nice set-closer [9]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer notes the segment after Space runs roughly fifteen minutes [10]
- **I Want To Tell You** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite version of the song the Dead played [16]
- Reviewer felt Jerry was especially on that night and the band locked in tightly [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Want To Tell You**: rare: 7 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd95-03-22.schoeps.11623.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 149 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Above-average recording with a noisy audience; a small dropout was fixed with shntool [1]
- **gd95-03-22.akg.12179.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 3.07/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording from 1995; reviewer calls the sound good considering its source [8]
- **gd1995-03-22.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.112628.Flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1995-03-22.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.112627.Flac1644**: audience recording; 17 songs; 147 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this as their first Grateful Dead show, at age 16 and a high-school junior, staying sober [5]
- During intermission, a man screamed uncontrollably for water [15]
- Reviewer finds it nearly as solid as the next night, which had Unbroken Chain, Scarlet and Fire jams [9]
- Show is overshadowed by the following night's Scarlet>Fire; the second set is short but strong [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-03-22.schoeps.11623.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Henry Wankleswurth and Candyman; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [1]
- **gd95-03-22.akg.12179.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience: AKG C460B / CK-8X short shotgun [2]
- **gd1995-03-22.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.112628.Flac2496**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D5; Taper:Baker,Transfer By Keo Tapes Maxell XLII-S 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1>Korg MR-1000 @ 1… [3]
- **gd1995-03-22.Nak300CP4.Baker.Keo.112627.Flac1644**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D5; Taper:Baker,Transfer By Keo Tapes Maxell XLII-S 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1>Korg MR-1000 @ 1… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-03-23 Charlotte Coliseum, Charlotte, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-03-23-charlotte-coliseum-charlotte-nc-usa/) [18]
